scope_outcomes.criterion: A secondary reader must substantively interpret the target thinker's position on a supplied engagement theme or introduce and support a relevant additional theme.
scope_outcomes.basis: The full held article was supplied and inspected. It substantively interprets Weber on meaning, historical anti-speculation, Marx and Weber, value-related knowledge, and bureaucracy, with nine retained anchored findings.
limitations: The article does not substantively cover all plan-spine themes, especially estates, social closure, political capitalism, imperialism and tax-farming.
The article is not evidence of Dylan Riley's own position.
The finding is limited to the supplied full held text and does not establish Ktenas's complete body of work or Weber's entire reception.
